pii_statement: This repository (claude-workflow-engine) contains NO PII. It is a SDLC orchestration engine operating on its own source code, policy documents, and pipeline telemetry -- there are no end-user records, no personal data fields, and audit_surface.json's 62 credential_access_sites are all API-token/secret env-var reads (GITHUB_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-class patterns), not personal-data fields. No PII subgraph, TAINTS_PII edges, or ComplianceTag(PII) nodes were emitted; this is a deliberate scope decision, not an unchecked gap.
